newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police seize eight tonnes of arms in raid.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police seize eight tonnes of arms in raid.

text.p: Police seized eight tonnes of arms, ammunition and explosives -- including mortars -- in a raid on an arms dealer near the southern Belgian town of Mons, Belgian media said on Wednesday.
The dealer, named as Marc Muller, was taken in for questioning but as of Wednesday morning he had been neither arrested nor charged, the media said.
No comment was available from the Special Investigation Brigade in Mons that was coordinating the operation.
Newspapers and radio speculated about possible links to gun running, an attack on two gendarmes in Bastogne in 1995 and a series of attacks last year on security vans.

They said French justice authorities had also expressed an interest in the weapons -- said to be old police and military surplus. France has suffered several attacks over the past 18 months that have been attributed to Islamic fundamentalists.
